quality.review_scope: Independently audited main-text SiO2/PbTe multilayer and sandwich production, silica background and source-linked characterization on main pages 2–4, Figures 1–3. The publisher cover and referenced original studies are excluded from scientific acceptance; unavailable SI was not audited. Silica thickness/deposition-rate tension, missing deposition details and specimen distinctions remain explicit.
missing_fields: Absolute precursor charges and gas flow rates; target consumption and film yield; substrate cleaning details and deposition-time uncertainties.
No measured sample-specific atomistic coordinates or unit cell. No external model downloaded.

Top/bottom silica PECVD times; per-variant PbTe-layer thickness; exact particle counts; explicit phase for 20 s and 40 s specimens; no crosswalk identifying the 8 nm general layer as one timed specimen.
requested_tasks: Different-agent full source audit and browser/asset review required before acceptance.
